verdict.rationale: Open licensing of source is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that SavvyCal publishes separate community open-source projects, such as a Phoenix adapter for Inertia.js. Nothing shows that the SavvyCal product's own source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
